findings.evidence: SRAM is excluded, but contract/admission do not explicitly state that bank_row_addresses output and bank_words input cut the address-to-memory-to-data timing path and use a generic 0.250ns bank-data input delay.
findings.impact: Logic-island slack/Fmax can be laundered as complete PWP lookup timing.
findings.required_fix: Carry machine-readable combinational_external_bank_model=true, synchronous_sram_interface=false and complete_pwp_lookup_timing=false flags through contract, admission and receipt.

findings.evidence: Current log shows ZeroWireload effective and one ideal clock, but Tcl omits explicit auto_wire_load_selection=false/set_wire_load_mode=top and sealing does not parse clock/wireload attributes.
findings.impact: Future tool/default drift may escape the textual admission.
findings.suggested_fix: Set wireload mode explicitly, report design/clock attributes and validate them in the receipt.

findings.evidence: Launcher creates an empty RUN_COMPLETE after checking only a small nonempty-file set; no final machine receipt or output manifest binds claim gates to reports/netlist.
findings.impact: Reports can be detached, replaced or summarized without logic-only labels.
findings.suggested_fix: Create nonempty receipt and SHA manifest after validation, repeating all negative claim gates.

findings.evidence: Post-run shell checks process/log/file presence but does not parse check_design/check_timing, unresolved references, clock, macro count, constraints or setup/hold status.
findings.impact: RUN_COMPLETE denotes file production rather than explicit constraint/link/timing status.
findings.suggested_fix: Build a receipt with separate tool_completed, netlist_link_clean, setup_met, hold_met, constraint_clean and macro_count fields.

closed_during_review.evidence: Hardened launcher exact-SHA checks contract, filelist, SDC, Tcl, M82, M85, VCS preconditions and both setup/min DBs; admission records launcher SHA, DB paths/hashes and operating condition.
Hardened launcher rejects any r1 period other than string 3.000 and any operating condition other than ssg0p9v125c.
Hardened launcher detects dc_shell, dc_shell-t and common_shell_exec -shell dc_shell, refuses existing output and atomically creates a per-output launch lock.

go: GO for the exact two-file M82+M85 production logic-island source closure.
GO for synchronous reset timing, SYNTHESIS define, ideal pre-CTS clock and effective ZeroWireload in the observed run.
GO for exact semantic-input/library SHA gates, canonical period/corner, common_shell_exec guard and atomic output lock.
no_go: NO-GO for complete PWP lookup timing until the SRAM port-cut abstraction is explicit in contract/admission/receipt.
NO-GO for M86-R3, complete PWP frontend, SRAM-inclusive timing/area, paper-ready PPA, energy, throughput, FPS or system speedup claims.
